record.what_it_does: The Meta Marketing API lets developers programmatically create, manage, and analyze ad campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and WhatsApp.
record.auth_notes: Third-party apps obtain a User Access Token via the Facebook Login OAuth dialog (scope e.g. ads_management/ads_read). Agencies/automation commonly use System User Access Tokens (long-lived static bearer tokens issued via Business Manager) instead of per-user OAuth for server-to-server automation.
record.access_notes: Any developer can create a Meta app and get 'Limited access' (Standard access) immediately, which is heavily rate-limited, dev-only, and restricted to accounts you already administer. To manage other people's ad accounts at production scale (the agent-toolkit case), the app must pass Meta App Review and be approved for 'Advanced access'/'Full access' to ads_management/ads_read, which also requires meeting call-volume thresholds (500+ Marketing API calls in 15 days, <15% error rate) and possibly Business Verification.
record.main_blocker: App Review / Advanced Access required to manage ad accounts on behalf of other users

evidence.quote: User access tokens let your app take actions in real time based on input from the user
System User access tokens let your app perform programmatic, automated actions on Ad objects or Pages
Advanced access must be approved through the App Review process on an individual permission and feature basis
Automatically granted when you add the Marketing API product to your app... Heavily rate-limited per ad account. For development only.
